'''Dalgeer's Rim''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] outpost situated in caverns under the [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] [[Mount Deldarca]]. It was a staging facility and secondary [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] outpost, staffed by personnel from every major branch of the Alliance. Named after its [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Dalgeer]], the based was built into the rim of Mount Deldarca and tapped the volcano for its [[Geothermal power generator/Legends|geothermal energy]]. The base was located within a series of natural and laser-tunneled caverns.<ref name="HS" />

Being located in a volcano's caldera, assignment to Dalgeer's Rim was not without potential danger. [[Groundquake/Legends|Groundquakes]] were common, and superheated [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] meant that all personnel carried [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] in case the facility's airtight [[shield door]]s could not be closed. Between fifty and a hundred personnel were assigned to the base at any time, involved in mission briefing and training.<ref name="HS" />

The base consisted of a large [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] capable of hold several [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] or a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of fighters. The bay was open to the volcano, and a [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic field]] kept the harmful gasses present in the caldera from entering the base. A laser-cut passageway known as the Chute connected the hangar to a volcanic vent. The vent could be used as a back-door to the hangar, but with risks since the volcano could expel hot poisonous gasses. A magnetic field separated the chute from the vent, while two shield doors could also be closed in the event of an emergency.<ref name="HS" />

Dalgeer's Rim was protected by concealed emplacements, including an [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[MX-10]] [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] and a Merr-Sonn [[TX-2020]] [[Laser cannon/Legends|double laser cannon]].<ref name="HS" />
